newsitem.title: THAILAND: New Thai finmin to announce his policies soon.
newsitem.headline: New Thai finmin to announce his policies soon.

text.p: New Thai finance minister Thanong Bidaya said on Friday that he would announce his policy initiatives to resuscitate the sputtering economy in two or three days time.
"Please give me two or three days to prepare and I will inform you about my policies," he told a his first news conference after his appointment.
When asked whether he would face the same fate as his predecsssor Amnuay who quit on Thursday, he said he was confident that he would receive full support from politicians in government.
Low profiled banker Thanong was president of Thai Military Bank before his cabinet appointment.

Amnuay quit after differences with political rivals in the six-party coalition government of Thai premier Chavalit Yongchaiyudh over his management of the ailing Thai economy which is going through its worst slump in over a decade.
"I believe that the coalition parties will honour capable people and the one they choose to be finance minister,: he said. "The fact that they nominated me indicates that."
"What the country needs most now is unity, not only will I seek cooperation from the government but also from the opposition," he added.
"I pledge to find appropriate policy measures which I can explain to all political parties," he said.
Thanong is the sixth finance minister Thailand has had since 1995 in three administrations.
